ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 75-80%) across the central ventral surface, contrasted with low-intensity black pixels (approx. 20-25%) along the trailing edges and median notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white fields occupy the majority of both lobes. High-contrast black mottling and dendritic patterns are clustered around the median notch and lower fluke base. Isolated black circular blobs are scattered across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees, extending roughly 15% into the total vertical depth of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (saw-tooth peaks and valleys) along the entire linear boundary from the median notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular black clusters (approx. 5 on the left lobe, 4 on the right lobe) distributed across the white ventral surface, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions (dark grey/black) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scarring consistent with sessile barnacle detachment and irregular serration patterns along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique splash-like black pigmentation pattern radiating from the median notch into the white fields of the inner lobes.
